touchpoints.name: Cloud columna
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Log WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Alerta tiempo aplicación evento
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE duration > 0.5 SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Panel motor
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Transaction WHERE error IS true SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Aplicación respuesta sistema vista
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Log WHERE error IS true SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Servicios dato consulta sistema
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Panel aplicación aplicación dato
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Span WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Respuesta sistema
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Span WHERE error IS true SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Rendimiento métrica sistema dato alerta
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Transaction WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago
